exact_statement: For every finite Boolean sign under every interior independent product law, put P_A=hat f(A)^2, c_A=hat f(A)/sqrt(v_A), Delta=I-Var, R=sum_{|A|>=3}(|A|-2)P_A, M=Delta-R and J_hi=ln4 sum_{|A|>=2}P_A j_A, where 1/2<2^j_A |c_A|<=1. The complete reference Q_* retains actual empty/singleton masses and distributes total high mass M in proportion to W_A=v_A 4^-j_A. Its normalizer satisfies 0<=n_hi=M ln(Z_hi/M)<=(ln4)(Delta-R), and E=E_single+J_hi+n_hi-KL(P||Q_*). Its complete corrected cross entropy is no greater than A044 flat-reference cross entropy, by the exact full-sector KL chain rule. With S=4Delta-2R-E_single>=0 and U=sum_high P_A ln(4(2^j_A|c_A|)^2)>=0, E=J_hi+(4+ln4)Delta-(2+ln4)R-S-U. These complete references compose through genuine disjoint prime decompositions with additive weighted ordinary KL and no lost terminals. A common J_hi<=KDelta for every precisely defined prime at every induced law implies universal corrected E<=(K+4+ln4)Delta and uniform bit FEI with constant max(K+4+ln4,1)/ln2. The prime high-scale bound is equivalent up to this additive constant to universal product-biased corrected FEI+ and remains unproved.
